title: Fifth Pylon and court
summary: Thutmose I’s gateway led into a court whose circulation was later changed by partitions.
orientation: On the main axis, at the eastern side of the Wadjet Hall.

claims.text: Thutmose I’s gateway led into a court whose circulation was later changed by partitions.
A casing of limestone above and red granite below covered the sandstone core.
Thutmose III divided the court into a central corridor and flanking pillared spaces. What began as an open space became more channelled.
The modeled wooden portico roof is not certain; a stone roof has also been proposed.
